comment: The demo library. Deliberately mixed, to show the assistant is not tuned
to one subject: machine learning, security, biology, economics and
astrophysics papers, plus non-academic documents (standards, government
reports) which have a completely different shape on the page.
Everything here is open access or public domain. Add or remove freely --
this file is the only thing that decides what the demo knows.
`excluded` documents nothing -- it is a note to a future reader about
documents deliberately left out and why. Run the ingest dry run before
adding a long document; a 500-page standard can cost a whole day.

direct.title: Computer Security Incident Handling Guide (NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 2)
Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology

excluded.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems (NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5)
excluded.why: 492 pages, 794 chunks -- 79% of Gemini's 1000/day free allowance for one document. Re-add it if you enable billing; `npm run corpus:ingest -- --dry-run` will tell you the cost of anything you add.
